name: ΑMT
toxicities: FreeODwiki says alpha-MT pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity data are limited and human non-medical use history is short. It cites a few unverified hospitalization reports above 60 mg and 22 deaths associated with alpha-MT in England and Wales from 2012 to early 2015; these are source-reported associations, not proof of causation.
effectsSummary: The archived page reports alpha-MT dose and duration from user/resource material; pharmacology, metabolism and toxicity data are limited and non-medical human-use history is short.
dosageRemark: Archived oral table: threshold 5 mg; light 10-25 mg; moderate 25-40 mg; strong 40-60 mg; severe 60-80 mg; total 13-15 h, onset 60-180 min. User/resource educational data, not a recommendation. The source mentions a few unverified hospitalization reports above 60 mg and 22 deaths associated with alpha-MT in England and Wales during 2012-early 2015; association does not establish causation. lightMin corrected from threshold to 10 mg.
generalRisks: The source recommends harm reduction and says adverse effects may become more likely as dose increases; subjective reports are anecdotal and unpredictable.
saferUse: FreeODwiki strongly recommends harm reduction because human safety evidence is limited.
Do not interpret the reported death association as proof of causation or the listed bands as safe limits.
summary: Alpha-MT is a psychedelic tryptamine with limited human pharmacology and toxicity data. FreeODwiki reports long oral duration and historical deaths associated with use, while noting evidence limitations.
